author: broyouremad
body: I was banned on Monday June 14, 2015 at 6:42 PM by DoctaPop. I was banned because DoctaPop accused me of hacking-flying. I was never on Monday June 14, 2015 because i'm not allowed to play on the weekdays. So please lift the ban because I am innocent and did nothing wrong.

title: Please unban me

replies.author: rinn
replies.body:
Hello,

I have decided to accept your appeal, as you have waited seven months as a banned user, and no evidence has been provided to support your initial ban. Welcome back to the server, and please be sure to read the updated rules:
https://avicus.net/rules

Regards,
Rinn
Avicus Network Senior Moderator
